Title: Document
Paris, the capital of France, is a global center for art, fashion, gastronomy, and culture. Its 19th-century cityscape is crisscrossed by wide boulevards and the River Seine. Beyond its administrative status as the nation's seat of government, the city is globally renowned for iconic architectural marvels. Foremost among these is the Eiffel Tower, completed in 1889, alongside the vast Louvre Museum, which houses the Mona Lisa, and the Gothic Notre-Dame cathedral on the Île de la Cité.
